title: Dynamics 365 finance and operations: data management framework telemetry in Application Insights
summary: Pass with corrections: the roadmap details, setup paths and Azure consumption costs are supported. The REST row needs method-and-path formatting, and the rollout checklist names a control missing from the table. The documentation does not explicitly establish that the signals are read-only.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an API or automation operation for the Application Insights Registry destination configuration.
claims.quote: Searched: finance operations "Application Insights Registry" "API" "Monitoring" telemetry configuration data entities; "Monitoring and Telemetry parameters" "data entity" OData API. Opened Get started with telemetry and read search results; no configuration operation found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an API or automation operation for enabling DMF telemetry types on Configure.
claims.quote: Searched: finance operations "DMF" "telemetry" configure disable API PowerShell; "Monitoring and Telemetry parameters" "data entity" OData API. Opened Available telemetry and Get started with telemetry; no operation for selecting DMF signals found.

claims.claim: Azure portal > Log Analytics workspaces > workspace > Usage and estimated costs > Daily Cap > ON sets a workspace daily ingestion cap.
claims.quote: From the Log Analytics workspaces menu, select your workspace, and then Usage and estimated costs. ... Select Daily Cap at the top of the page. ... Select ON and then set the data volume limit in GB/day.

claims.claim: The printed PUT workspace operation at api-version=2026-03-01 sets properties.workspaceCapping.dailyQuotaGb with the supplied location.
claims.quote: PUT https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/{workspaceName}?api-version=2026-03-01 ... properties.workspaceCapping ... dailyQuotaGb ... The workspace daily quota for ingestion.
claims.fix: Replace controls[2].api.call and its rendered cell with 'PUT https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/<ws>?api-version=2026-03-01'. Append to controls[2].note: 'The request body sets properties.workspaceCapping.dailyQuotaGb.' The endpoint, version and printed body keys are documented; remove the body from the call to follow the standard.

claims.claim: The workspace cap stops collection of billable log data in Analytics and Basic tables, not just DMF signals.
claims.quote: stopping collection of billable log data for tables in the Analytics or Basic table plans

claims.claim: Auxiliary tables are exempt from daily caps.
claims.quote: Tables in the Auxiliary table plan are not subject to any daily cap.

claims.claim: Reaching the cap stops collection for the remainder of the cap period and interrupts telemetry-based monitoring and alerts.
claims.quote: for the rest of a 24-hour period whenever your specified threshold is reached. ... This will impact your ability to monitor resources, receive alerts

claims.claim: Data collected above the daily cap is still billed.
claims.quote: If data is collected above the cap, it's still billed.

claims.claim: For workspace-based Application Insights, the effective daily cap is the minimum of the Application Insights and Log Analytics settings.
claims.quote: For workspace-based Application Insights resources, the effective daily cap is the minimum of the two settings.

claims.claim: Setting a workspace cap requires Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/write, available through Log Analytics Contributor.
claims.quote: Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/write permissions to the Log Analytics workspaces you set the daily cap on, as provided by the Log Analytics Contributor built-in role, for example.

claims.claim: Application Insights Component Contributor provides permission to set a classic Application Insights daily cap.
claims.quote: microsoft.insights/components/CurrentBillingFeatures/write permissions ... as provided by the Application Insights Component Contributor built-in role, for example.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: A DMF-specific telemetry price or cost per job is not published in the documentation found.
claims.quote: Searched: finance operations DMF telemetry price licensing data volume per job; opened Available telemetry and Understand and control costs. Found general ingestion and retention charges, but no DMF-specific price or per-job cost.

claims.quote: Searched: finance operations DMF telemetry price licensing data volume per job; opened Available telemetry and Understand and control costs. Neither gives a DMF-specific event size, event count per job or volume estimate.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The cited telemetry pages do not describe the customer-data field contents of DMF events or error messages.
claims.quote: Searched: finance operations DMF telemetry event fields error messages entity file names modifies jobs; read Available telemetry, Get started with telemetry, overview and costs. Results describe error codes and monitoring, not the emitted DMF payload fields.

claims.claim: The getting-started telemetry prerequisites do not name an administrator role for the finance and operations configuration steps.
claims.quote: Searched: finance operations "Application Insights Registry" "API" "Monitoring" telemetry configuration data entities; read the full Get started with telemetry prerequisite and configuration sections. They name the application and steps, not a required administrator role.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends collecting only essential telemetry in production to reduce costs.
claims.quote: Configure Application Insights to collect only essential telemetry in production environments. This approach reduces data volume and associated costs.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends sampling as a telemetry cost-control strategy.
claims.quote: Sampling reduces telemetry traffic, data costs, and storage costs, while preserving a statistically correct analysis of application data.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends adjusting data retention settings as a telemetry cost-control strategy.
claims.quote: Adjust data retention settings in Application Insights to align them with your organization's compliance and analysis requirements.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends Microsoft Cost Management tools and alerts for unusual Application Insights spending.
claims.quote: Use Microsoft Cost Management tools to monitor Application Insights usage and set up alerts for unusual spending patterns.

claims.claim: Microsoft suggests considering daily ingestion caps and warns that reaching them can cause data loss.
claims.quote: To prevent unexpected cost overruns, consider setting daily caps on data ingestion. Be careful, because data loss might occur if the cap is reached.

claims.claim: The signals are read-only reporting of job start, end and status.
claims.quote: Searched: finance operations DMF telemetry event fields error messages entity file names modifies jobs; opened Available telemetry and Monitoring and telemetry overview. They document logging and monitoring, but do not explicitly characterize the signals as read-only.
claims.fix: Replace 'The signals are read-only reporting of job start, end and status.' with 'The signals report job start, end and status.' Available telemetry documents those three reporting functions.

claims.claim: The sources read do not say the DMF telemetry feature changes jobs.
claims.quote: Searched: finance operations DMF telemetry event fields error messages entity file names modifies jobs; opened Available telemetry, Monitoring and telemetry overview and Get started with telemetry. They describe monitoring and logging, not modifications to DMF jobs.

claims.claim: The pages read document no separate DMF-only signal-off control other than the Configure telemetry selection.
claims.quote: Searched: finance operations "DMF" "telemetry" configure disable API PowerShell; opened Available telemetry and Get started with telemetry. Found Configure signal selection and support-managed flights, but no other documented DMF-only signal-off setting.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The checklist instructs enabling Monitoring and Telemetry, but the controls table has no row for that control.
claims.quote: Checklist: Enable the Monitoring and Telemetry feature in the Feature management workspace. Table: Application Insights resource registry, telemetry types, and workspace daily ingestion cap.
claims.fix: Remove the At rollout bullet 'Enable the **Monitoring and Telemetry** feature in the **Feature management** workspace.' Keep the documented prerequisite in Scope; do not add a controls row.

claims.claim: The emitted telemetry spend is charged through Azure rather than through Dynamics 365.
claims.quote: This article describes the different ways that Azure Monitor charges for usage and how to evaluate charges on your Azure bill.
claims.fix: Add 'Azure Monitor cost and usage' at https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/fundamentals/cost-usage to sources to support the statement that the charges appear on the Azure bill.
